lines.cap: Rich people can tell if you're one of them with one handshake. You've probably failed it already.
lines.say: Rich people can tell if you're one of them with one handshake. You've probably failed it already.

lines.cap: It's not the grip. It's the thumb. Three taps. Slow. Fast. Slow.
lines.say: It's not the grip. It's the thumb. Three taps. Slow. Fast. Slow.

lines.cap: If they're old money, they tap back twice. That means: we see you.
lines.say: If they're old money, they tap back twice. That means: we see you.

lines.cap: Get it wrong and the smile stays. But the invitation never comes.
lines.say: Get it wrong and the smile stays. But the invitation never comes.

lines.cap: One intern guessed the code at a gala. He tapped three times. They tapped back.
lines.say: One intern guessed the code at a gala. He tapped three times. They tapped back.

lines.cap: Next morning he was promoted. To the moon.
lines.say: Next morning he was promoted. To the moon.

lines.cap: Try it on your friend. If they tap back twice, run.
lines.say: Try it on your friend. If they tap back twice, run.

lines.cap: Tag who just tapped their own hand. Because rich people can tell
lines.say: Tag who just tapped their own hand. Because rich people can tell
